top_signals.title: Citi's Luet Sees AI Infrastructure Theme Continuing
top_signals.summary: Citi's Japan, Asia North and Australia Cluster and Banking Head Marc Luet expects AI infrastructure investment to remain a dominant theme, despite growing scrutiny. He speaks after data center firm Nextdc shares plunged following a public backlash. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Elice's huge stock swings show AI's spending boom is getting more investor scrutiny
top_signals.summary: The AI boom is entering a more unforgiving phase, as investors question whether the billions poured into data centers will translate into sustainable profits.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Stolen UpdraftCentral keys used to backdoor WordPress sites
top_signals.summary: A threat actor breached TeamUpdraft's website, a developer of popular WordPress backup and security plugins, potentially compromising UpdraftCentral connection keys that can send commands to connected websites. [...]
